//: The harness scripts, type-checked as they are: JavaScript with JSDoc, no
build, no second copy. A file opts in with `// @ts-check` on its first line;
one without it is visibly unchecked. Referenced from tsconfig.build.json, so
verify.sh step 02 covers the scripts the gate itself runs.
Declarations are emitted, because a referenced project may not disable emit,
and they go under .generated/ where nothing reads them.
